verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an MCP server that lets external LLM agents (e.g. in Claude/Cursor) call its API and docs, and CLI tooling for agents, but there is no evidence of an AI assistant built into the Appwrite Console/dashboard itself that a user can converse with to write queries, debug errors, or explain their backend. The MCP server is a client-facing integration for external AI tools, not an in-dashboard assistant.
